title: Duality and a Canonical Sheaf in Periodic Riemann Functions
summary: Let $f\colon{\mathbb Z}^2\to{\mathbb Z}$ be a Riemann function whose weight $W$ is a perfect matching. Then there is a family of sheaves of $k$-vector spaces $\{{M}_{W,{\bf d}}\}_{{\bf d}\in{\mathbb Z}^2}$ on a five-point topological that models $f$ in that $f({\bf d})=b^0({M}_{W,{\bf d}})$ and that $$ b^1({M}_{W,{\bf d}})= f^\wedge_{\bf K}({\bf d}-{\bf K}) $$ for any ${\bf K}\in{\mathbb Z}^2$. Hence a Riemann-Roch formula for $f$ is equivalent to an Euler characteristic computation of ${M}_{W,{\bf d}}$. If $f$ and $W$ are $r$-periodic, then the sheaves ${M}_{W,{\bf d}}$ become…
